name: Counter-Strike 1.6

scale.why: player hull 72 u tall (as Half-Life), scaled to 1.8 m: 0.025 m/u

speed.note: knife out; rifles are slower (AK-47 221, AWP 210)

ground_accel.note: engine default; many servers and configs run 5

stop_speed.note: engine default; competitive configs often use 75

air_accel.note: Quark-equivalent: this engine pushes 10 x the FULL wish speed (250 u/s) per second but caps the gain at 30 u/s; Quark pushes air_accel x 10 x min(wish, air_cap), so the same push is air_accel = 10 x 250 / 30 / 10 (Xonotic's Quake port does the same: sv_airaccelerate 106.67 with sv_maxairspeed 30 for 10 x 320 / 30).

air_cap.note: the air wish-speed cap (Quark's air strafe cap, W-only; A/D raises Quark's x1.1)

overstrafe.source: same code: the push is applied in full whatever its angle to your velocity
overstrafe.note: no overstrafe softening: the whole push against your momentum applies (Quark lets 35% through)

timeTo90.source: derived from this file's speed, ground_accel, friction, stop_speed
timeTo90.note: Quake ground model at 1 ms steps (friction then accelerate), the same way Quark's physsim measures its own run_up / stop presets; edge friction not modelled; Quark: 0.072 s

stopDistance.source: derived from this file's speed, friction, stop_speed
stopDistance.note: Quake ground model at 1 ms steps (friction then accelerate), the same way Quark's physsim measures its own run_up / stop presets; edge friction not modelled; Quark: 1.21 m

stopTime.source: derived from this file's speed, friction, stop_speed
stopTime.note: Quake ground model at 1 ms steps (friction then accelerate), the same way Quark's physsim measures its own run_up / stop presets; edge friction not modelled; Quark: 0.364 s

extras: jump penalty: each jump sets a 1315.8 ms timer that cuts the next jump's speed to as little as 75% and slows you after landing (pm_shared.cpp#L2812-2820, #L1060)
bunny-hop limit: above 1.2 x maxspeed a jump crops speed to 0.8 x that (pm_shared.h#L74, pm_shared.cpp#L2596-2610)
notes: Game code from ReGameDLL_CS (a reverse-engineered CS 1.6 game library), engine cvars from ReHLDS.
